personality: 6 Glass / Luxe (Adapted for Light Mode/White with Red & Pink accents)
personality_one_liner: A cinematic, highly polished luxurious dating experience that feels expensive, using striking white, deep crimson, and warm rose to frame the live connections.

spacing.rule: Generous cinematic spacing. Content should breathe. Use md/lg for internal card padding, and xl/2xl between sections.

do's: Use heavy glass panels (expo-blur) over the video feed for overlays like partner name, match status, and the Next button.
Use glassmorphism for the Auth screen card against the abstract bokeh background.
Layer a tinted scrim (surfaceInverse gradient) between the background video/image and text to ensure contrast.
dont's: Do not apply blur over form inputs or standard profile text.
Do not use heavy drop shadows; let the glass and background blur handle elevation.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Elegant login and registration to enter the premium Sugar experience.

states.loading: Centered loading spinner on glass panel.

screens.layout: Full-bleed luxurious abstract background image (`auth_hero`). A glassmorphic card (blurred, surface white at 70% opacity) centered on the screen holding the email/password inputs. Large 'Sugar' display serif logo at the top.

screens.name: ProfileVerification
screens.purpose: Verify identity via selfie upload for a premium, trusted dating pool.

states.loading: Uploading selfie with a subtle progress ring.
states.empty: Prompt to 'Take a Selfie' inside a large dashed rounded card.

screens.layout: Clean white base (surface). Editorial serif heading. Large hero card displaying the ID/Selfie mock image (`verification_demo`). A sticky primary CTA 'Submit Verification' pinned to the bottom.

screens.name: Lobby
screens.purpose: Welcome the user and request camera permissions before entering the live dating pool.
screens.layout: Full-bleed camera feed (or `auth_hero` background if permission not yet granted). Large serif greeting 'Welcome to Sugar'. A massive sticky 'Start Dating' brandPrimary CTA anchored at the bottom.

screens.name: VideoStage
screens.purpose: Live random video chatting. Swipe left or tap Next to disconnect instantly.

states.loading: Searching for Sugar... A cinematic pulsating glass circle over a blurred background.
states.error: Connection lost, retry button on glass panel.

screens.layout: Full-screen partner feed image (`partner_demo`) acting as a mock WebRTC video. A top-to-bottom gradient scrim guarantees UI contrast. A small PiP window (`self_demo`) with a white border at the top right. A bold glass 'Next' pill button at the bottom center, and swipe gestures enabled on the whole screen to trigger the Next action. Partner name in a sleek glass chip.

auth_hero.alt: Soft pink and white luxury bokeh lights

partner_demo.alt: Cinematic portrait of a young woman

partner_demo_male.alt: Cinematic portrait of a young man

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: White background with deep crimson (brandPrimary) and warm rose (brandSecondary).
Use Playfair Display for headings/logos and DM Sans for body/inputs (load using @expo-google-fonts).
The 'Video Stage' MUST use a full-bleed absolute-positioned mock image (partner_demo) to simulate WebRTC.
Include a gradient scrim (top to bottom, transparent to 70% surfaceInverse) on the Video Stage to ensure the 'Next' button and partner name remain readable against the video feed.
Implement the 'Next' action using a Swipe left gesture (react-native-gesture-handler) across the screen OR the explicit 'Next' pill button at the bottom.
In the Lobby, structure a visually rich 'Searching for Sugar...' state (e.g., using Reanimated to pulse a glass circle).
Do NOT use generic blue or indigo colors. Stick to the luxury red/pink/white theme.

Implement the gender-individualized aspect by defaulting to 'brandPrimary' (Crimson) but allowing 'brandSecondary' (Rose) to be swapped in for female-identified flows/components if possible, or use them as a gradient.
Ensure all buttons are wrapped in a Pressable with 0.98 scale down effect and no heavy shadows.
